quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): total revenue RMB457.3 billion, up 25.0% year-over-year, and adjusted net profit RMB39.2 billion, up 43.8%, both record highs; profit for the year RMB41.6 billion, up 76.3%; gross profit margin 22.3% (20.9% in 2024). Smartphone x AIoT segment revenue RMB351.2 billion (+5.4%) at a record 21.7% gross margin; smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment revenue RMB106.1 billion (+223.8%; RMB103.3 billion from smart EV and RMB2.8 billion from other related businesses) at a 24.3% gross margin, and the segment achieved positive income from operations for the first time, RMB0.9 billion. Revenue outside the Chinese Mainland, mainly from Europe and India, was 33.0% of the total (41.9% in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB457.3 billion (+25.0%); adjusted net profit RMB39.2 billion (+43.8%); smart EV, AI and other new initiatives revenue RMB106.1 billion (+223.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: Smartphones FY2025 (annual report): revenue RMB186.4 billion, down 2.8%, on shipments of 165.2 million units (down 2.0% from 168.5 million, mainly lower shipments in India, partly offset by the Chinese Mainland, Latin America and Africa) at an ASP of RMB1,128.7 per unit (RMB1,138.2 in 2024). Smartphone gross margin fell from 12.6% to 10.9%, mainly due to the reduction in national subsidies in the Chinese Mainland, the increased price of key components in the second half of the year and increased competition in the global market. The company cites Omdia for a top-3 global shipment ranking for the 5th consecutive year with 13.3% share, and third-party data for No. 2 in the Chinese Mainland with 16.6% share; premium smartphones (retail price at or above RMB3,000) were 27.1% of Chinese Mainland units sold. In December 2025 Xiaomi upgraded its Global Imaging Strategic Cooperation with Leica to a 'Strategic Co-creation Model', with the Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica as its first product; the Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi launched globally in February 2026 from EUR999, EUR1,499 and EUR1,999. The report names Xiaomi's self-developed application processor, the Xiaomi XRING O1.
quarterly_data.figure: smartphone revenue RMB186.4 billion (-2.8%); 165.2 million units; ASP RMB1,128.7; gross margin 10.9% (from 12.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: IoT and internet FY2025 (annual report): IoT and lifestyle products revenue a record RMB123.2 billion, up 18.3%, at a record 23.1% gross margin; smart large home appliances revenue up 23.1%, with air conditioner shipments over 8.5 million units (up over 24%), refrigerators over 2.8 million (up over 4%) and washing machines over 2.3 million (up over 18%); the appliances entered the European market in 2025 (Spain, France, Germany, Italy); tablet revenue up 30.2% and wearables up 30.7%; the company cites Omdia for Xiaomi AI Glasses shipments ranking No. 3 globally. Connected IoT devices (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) reached 1,079.2 million at December 31, 2025, up 19.3%. Internet services revenue RMB37.4 billion (+9.7%) at a 76.5% gross margin; advertising revenue a record RMB28.5 billion (+15.2%); overseas internet services revenue RMB12.6 billion (+15.2%), 33.8% of internet services revenue; December 2025 global MAU 754.1 million (+7.4%).
quarterly_data.figure: IoT revenue RMB123.2 billion (+18.3%); internet services RMB37.4 billion (+9.7%); advertising RMB28.5 billion (+15.2%); 1,079.2 million connected IoT devices

quarterly_data.signal: Smart EV FY2025 (annual report): deliveries 411,082 vehicles, up 200.4% from 136,854, on the introduction of the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra and Xiaomi YU7 Series and higher SU7 deliveries; smart EV revenue RMB103.3 billion (+221.8%) at an ASP of RMB251,171 per unit (+7.1%); 477 smart EV sales centers across 138 cities in the Chinese Mainland at December 31, 2025. The New-Generation SU7 launched in March 2026 at RMB219,900, RMB249,900 and RMB303,900 (Standard, Pro, Max): a silicon carbide high-voltage platform across the lineup, the Xiaomi HyperEngine V6s Plus with 94% battery-to-wheel energy transmission efficiency, a CLTC range of up to 902km (Pro), LiDAR and 700 TOPS of assisted-driving computing power as standard, and the Xiaomi HAD system on the Xiaomi XLA architecture; locked-in orders exceeded 15,000 within 34 minutes of launch and 30,000 in the first 3 days.
quarterly_data.figure: 411,082 deliveries (+200.4%); smart EV revenue RMB103.3 billion (+221.8%); ASP RMB251,171; New-Generation SU7 locked-in orders over 30,000 in 3 days

quarterly_data.signal: AI models and robotics (annual report): in December 2025 Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Flash, a Mixture-of-Experts model with 309 billion total and 15 billion active parameters; in March 2026 it released the flagship Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro (over 1 trillion total parameters with 42 billion active, context window of up to 1 million tokens; the company says it ranked 1st in token usage on OpenRouter from March 12 to March 23, 2026), plus Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Omni (omni multimodal model unifying text, vision and speech) and Xiaomi MiMo-V2-TTS (text-to-speech). The Xiaomi miclaw mobile agent, built on MiMo, entered invitation beta testing in March 2026. In February 2026 Xiaomi open-sourced its first robotics vision-language-action model, Xiaomi-Robotics-0 (4.7 billion parameters); in a March 2026 demonstration at the Xiaomi EV factory its robots operated autonomously for 3 consecutive hours at the self-piercing nut loading workstation with a 90.2% success rate at the line's fastest 76-second takt time.
quarterly_data.figure: MiMo-V2-Pro over 1 trillion parameters (42 billion active); MiMo-V2-Flash 309 billion parameters (15 billion active); Xiaomi-Robotics-0 4.7 billion parameters

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and investment (annual report): FY2025 R&D expenses RMB33.1 billion, up 37.8%; R&D personnel a record 25,457 at year-end; cumulative R&D expenses over the past five years RMB105.5 billion. The company expects its cumulative R&D expenses over the next five years (2026-2030) to exceed RMB200 billion. FY2025 capital expenditures RMB18,157.0 million (2024: RMB10,480.2 million), of which RMB12,023.8 million in the smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment and RMB6,133.2 million in smartphone x AIoT. The overall net margin of the hardware business was 2.3% in 2025, within the company's pledge of not more than 5% a year.
quarterly_data.figure: cumulative 2026-2030 R&D expected to exceed RMB200 billion; FY2025 R&D RMB33.1 billion (+37.8%); FY2025 capex RMB18,157.0 million

quarterly_data.signal: Customers, suppliers and channels (annual report): the five largest customers accounted for approximately 13.1% of FY2025 revenue and the largest approximately 8.5%, with no single external customer at 10% or more (2024: Customer A 10.5%); the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 30.9% of purchases and the largest approximately 12.1% (none named). Purchases of goods and services from associates of the group were RMB35,977,646 thousand (2024: RMB43,724,394 thousand). About 18,000 Xiaomi stores in the Chinese Mainland at December 2025 (net addition of more than 3,000; about 240 large-format stores) and about 450 overseas new retail stores (net addition of more than 435). Xiaomi's third self-owned factory, the Xiaomi Smart Home Appliances Factory, commenced operations at the end of 2025 and can produce one air conditioner every 6.5 seconds.
quarterly_data.figure: five largest customers about 13.1%, largest 8.5%; five largest suppliers about 30.9%, largest 12.1%
